theme: Light theme primary for marketing (outdoor, sunny, curb-appeal), Dark/High-Contrast theme for Admin Dashboard.

headings.usage: Hero headers, section titles, pricing package names. Never center-align by default.

body.usage: Paragraphs, labels, button text, all dashboard UI.

accent.usage: Overlines, tags, small descriptors, 5 R's headers.

surfaces: Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 with 1px border-white/40 for Sticky Nav and floating image stats.
The Tracing Beam: Apply via framer-motion to the 'Upgraded Package' card border to highlight it as the premium choice.
Solid Sharp: Flat white backgrounds with 1px border-[#EAE7E0] for Admin dashboard widgets.
textures: Subtle noise overlay (bg-noise) on the dark footer (#0C1627) to mimic premium matte paper/texture.

grids.bento_marketing: MODE A: THE TETRIS GRID. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Create asymmetry for the 5 R's.
grids.dashboard: MODE B: High Density. grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Every pixel utilized, h-full on children.

layouts.hero: Asymmetrical. Huge typography left-aligned overlapping a high-quality architectural image spanning the right 60%. Dark overlay max bg-[#0C1627]/30 to let the architecture breathe.
layouts.services_bento: The 5 R's must not be a boring list. Use the Tetris grid: 'Replace' gets col-span-8 row-span-2, 'Reset' gets col-span-4 row-span-1. Inject negative space.
layouts.pricing: Generous spacing (py-24). The 3 packages must use pure HTML/Tailwind for custom layouts. Center the 'Upgraded' card, scale it slightly (scale-105), and elevate.
layouts.before_after: High-contrast visual block. Dark background (#0C1627), showing image comparison of a rusted box vs a polished premium box.
layouts.booking_form: Minimalist multi-step flow. Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select, but stripped of default 'Vercel' look to match the luxury brand.

components.marquee: Use 'react-fast-marquee'. Mode: The Editorial Ribbon. Slow drift, font-serif, text-sm, gap-32. Used for Trust Band: 'Fully Insured • Local Experts • 5-Star Rated'.
components.buttons: Primary: bg-[#0C1627] text-white rounded-none or rounded-sm. Hover: bg-[#1A2536] with -translate-y-0.5. Accent: bg-[#C5A059] text-white.
components.cards: Avoid generic Shadcn Cards for marketing layout. Build pure div blocks with p-12 padding. For dashboard, use Shadcn Cards with sharp edges.
components.accordion: Use Shadcn Accordion for FAQs. Customize with a clean bottom border and + / - icons.

motion.hover: transition-transform duration-300 ease-out, transition-colors duration-300 ease-out.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up (opacity 0 to 1, translate-y-8 to 0) for bento grid items using Framer Motion.
motion.scroll: Install and use 'lenis' for smooth scrolling on the marketing page. This is MANDATORY for the premium feel.

accessibility.contrast: APCA contrast standards. Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text. NEVER use grey-on-grey.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query for all Framer Motion and Marquee elements.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='package-select-button').

media.3d_libraries: Framer Motion 3D for subtle parallax depths on Hero and Before/After cards. No heavy R3F needed (context is physical architecture/photos).

image_urls.description: Beautiful modern suburban home exterior (Hero Background)
Clean, structured driveway and front entrance (After/Polished)
Weathered wood or distressed texture (Before/Rusted concept)
Craftsman tools, architectural detail (Background for 5 R's)

instructions_to_main_agent: NEVER use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings. Use Cormorant Garamond for Headings and Manrope for Body.
Do NOT use pure #000000 or #FFFFFF for backgrounds. Follow the provided color palette (Bone White, Stone Grey, Slate Navy).
Apply Lenis smooth scrolling to the marketing page. Standard browser scroll breaks the premium feel.
Build the 5 R's section using the Bento Grid 'Tetris' pattern. Avoid uniform columns. Inject negative space.
Use 'react-fast-marquee' for the Trust Band, styling it as an 'Editorial Ribbon'.
Integrate Shadcn UI components for the Booking form and Admin Dashboard. Do not use raw HTML inputs.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-form-submit-button').
For the hero image overlay, max opacity is bg-[#0C1627]/30. Ensure the architecture remains visible.
Do NOT center-align paragraph text. Left-align text for readability, especially in the 5 R's and Pricing sections.
The admin dashboard must be cleanly separated from the marketing landing page, prioritizing high-density data display over large typography.
Install 'lucide-react' for icons. Do NOT use emojis.
For the booking form, structure it as a clean multi-step wizard instead of a long wall of inputs.
Create the app components using .js files as configured by the project workspace, ensuring compatibility with standard React practices.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js
GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: Implement clear visual hierarchy. Group related content logically. Provide immediate feedback on user interactions. Keep form fields minimal. Ensure touch targets on mobile are at least 44x44px. Establish a clear 'happy path' for the primary CTA (Booking).
